svg.title: #9 0 CONNALLY DR, East Point (19.9 ac tax roll)
svg.text: #9 0 CONNALLY DR, East Point (19.9 ac tax roll)
rear-load 310 deep, court only, cars at office end (market depth,
Trailer stalls 0 (court rows 0, drop yard 0) vs target 51
Site 21.5 ac (county map) 11,800 SF/gross ac FAR 0.27
Access: truck (T) + car (C); major collector, GDOT route
Graded area: relief ~12 ft, balanced cut/fill ~20,000 CY, steep 0%
!! USE_PERMIT_REQUIRED: East Point: warehousing is use-permit only
in I-1/I-2 and needs 5,280 ft from residential (draft reading)
! RESIDENTIAL_EDGE: about 283 ft of boundary touches residential
parcels (county land-use codes); draft buffers applied
! HEIGHT_CAP: draft height cap 40 ft: clear height lowered to 30
! TRAILER_SHORT: 0 trailer stalls against a target of 51
! ZONING_DRAFT: setbacks and buffers are draft screening values
for east point; zoning_rules.json is the authority
! STREAMS_PIPELINES: stream lines and petroleum pipelines are not
mapped; mapped water, wetlands and floodplain get a 25 ft buffer
i DOOR_DENSITY_HIGH: under 14 ft of dock wall per door
i POND_SITE_FROM_LIDAR: pond placed low, near the module and on
its side of mapped wetlands; no outfall, maintenance drive or
paving envelope (draft setbacks/buffers, 25 ft from water)
Screening test fit from public data: not a survey, civil design or zoning
determination. Zoning values are draft; detention is a +/-30% estimate;
routes, fire access and grading are indicative.
